thread:
anya: FYI found a cluster of late telemetry for 'user_search_latency' that landed after our daily ingest window.
mike: how late and how many keys are affected?
anya: ~36 hours late windows across 3 shards, ~120k event rows. It skews the 95th pct metric by ~18ms for a subset of customers.
sam: ouch. Is this from replayed logs or ingestion lag? Any root cause?
anya: appears to be a delayed S3 write from a partner pipeline + an upstream retry storm. Not replayed by us yet.
lisbeth: do we need a full recompute or can we patch aggregates with delta updates?
anya: delta patching looks messy because we lost original grouping keys for some events. safer to recompute aggregates for the affected date range.
mike: what's the window? we should estimate cost and SLA impact before kicking off a heavy backfill.
anya: target window: 2025-02-10T00:00 -> 2025-02-12T23:59 UTC (3 days). Estimated compute: 8 node-hours if we run at normal priority.
sam: can we run it in priority lane with a small slot to reduce time but not blow billing?
lisbeth: priority lane will preempt normal workloads; ops needs heads-up. Also UI will show misleading freshness while recompute runs.
console-team: we can add a console banner + a per-tenant freshness badge for the agg endpoint. Do we want a canary rollout flag to show 'recomputing' state? :thinking_face:
anya: yes add banner and an internal flag. we should also run a dry-run to validate idempotency before the real run.
replay-bot: replay schedule created: dry-run job queued -> job: telemetry-recompute-dryrun-4512349999 -> estimated runtime 30m.
mike: for the dry-run, please run 10% sample and compare match rate with current aggregates.
anya: dry-run will emit a checksum table and top-10 mismatches. I'll post results.
sam: also add a preflight that checks shard hotness and throttles if slot contention > 70%.
lisbeth: + add a quota cap so this backfill can't exceed X compute cost (e.g., 12 node-hours) without explicit approval.
anya: noted. I'll set quota cap to 12 node-hours and preempt policy to 'yield to dedicated-dbs'.
console-team: for UX, we should expose a 'recompute preview' link that shows sample rows and expected delta per tenant. small mockup later.
mike: one operational ask: have automatic fallback to partial-apply if full recompute fails. e.g., apply recompute per-shard and mark remaining shards for manual review.
anya: agreed. We'll run per-shard transactions with idempotent writes + checkpointing to S3.
sam: make sure to tag all compute with cost-center labels so finance can reconcile.
replay-bot: dry-run complete. output: sample-match-rate: 98.6%, top mismatch causes: dedupe-key collisions (42%), timezone-parsing drift (22%).
anya: drift noted. timezone parsing fix is small, will patch parser and re-run dry-run before full run.
mike: after the parser fix, run another dry-run sample. if match>99.5%, approve full recompute under quota.
lisbeth: schedule: parser fix + dry-run retest today, full recompute tomorrow morning with priority-lane window 03:00-06:00 UTC. Ops informed.
console-team: I'll add the banner and preview link; will also wire a 'cancel' button for ops to abort the recompute run.
anya: thanks everyone. I'll post the run playbook and the S3 checkpoint layout in this thread in a bit. :thumbsup:
